claim: On host macos-m5pro-20260924 (Apple M5 Pro, 18 cores, 24 GB unified memory, macOS arm64), rtk 0.49.0 (the catalog pin) reported its version, then ran as a CLI proxy: rtk git status in a scratch clone of this repository returned the compacted branch and working-tree status (all commands exit 0). rtk is installed through mise and pinned outside this repository: command -v rtk resolves to mise's rtk 0.49.0 install, and the host's mise global config pins rtk = "0.49.0" (both in the first command's output).
limitations: CLI-only use: rtk is not wired into Claude Code hooks on this host, so this receipt does not cover hook-based command rewriting, client attribution or token savings, and no rtk gain report was read.
One read-only git status in a scratch clone; other rtk filters and a size comparison against raw git output were not exercised.

Raw-output and failure-recovery behavior were not exercised: there was no unfiltered rtk run or rtk proxy call and no failing underlying command, so this receipt does not show what rtk returns or keeps when a command fails.

This receipt replaces an earlier recording from the same day under the same id; the recorder derives the id from host, component, stage and UTC date. That version and its independent agree review are preserved at commit cef7a74 on PR #185. The reviewer asked for this re-record so that the install and pin evidence is retained in the commands.

Recorded outside Claude Code's Seatbelt sandbox, in a scratch clone of this repository (adoption/update.md), not in the host's pinned install checkout. adoption/manifest.json keeps macos-arm64 at drafted_not_accepted, and this receipt changes no platform_status. Supports conditional now; accepted needs an independent review.
